preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call callget() function
Victim address must have BOND token balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function to transfer BOND tokens from any victim address to your own address. The function lacks proper access control checks on the _from parameter, allowing the owner to steal tokens from any address without approval. First ensure you have owner role, then call callget(victim_address, attacker_address, amount).
